method.weights: Each cpuprofile sample weighted by its matching timeDelta in microseconds. Inclusive time sums descendant samples. Function aggregation de-duplicates recursive appearances per sample.
limitations: Sampled milliseconds are estimated occupied stack time, not function invocation counts. hitCount/sample count is not call count.
Page V8 sampling excludes GPU process and does not cover all native renderer/driver threads.
Short15s profiled battery runs are not production CPU acceptance pairs and are not pooled with previous3AC+2battery pairs.

scene.scope: Distinct identities reachable from the current scene, including hidden/offscreen meshes, shared/material arrays and custom depth/distance/scene-override materials. Temporary identity sets are released after this call. GPU renderer info is a different inventory of allocated objects/cached programs, not bytes or VRAM. Renderer-generated and off-scene materials are excluded; no retained-resource/GC-completion or leak-proof claim.

lifecycle.scope: Page JS API counts; observers with live observed targets, plus live observer instances. Includes benchmark collector; weak references do not force GC. No worker/native scheduler claim.
